facts.fact: Balai reports Cabo Verde's national statistics institute INE found in its 2025 continuous multi-purpose survey that 77.3% of people aged 10 and over used the internet in the previous three months, up from 74% in 2024.
Balai reports INE's 2025 ICT statistics report says 78.2% of people aged 10 and over in Cabo Verde own a mobile phone.
